title: Stale Attachment Check
summary: Flags an attachment that looks like an older copy, e.g. report_v2.pdf attached while report_v3_final.pdf was edited today.
description: Attachment check against nearby files: a newer save of the same document, names saying draft, old, copy or (1), Office lock files and files dated before the subject's date, with a one-tap swap to the newer file and Undo.
catches: A newer file of the same document nearby
Names containing draft, old, copy or (1)
Files last modified before a date named in the subject
One-tap swap to the newer file, with Undo
limits: Only sees the nearby files you pass; it can't browse folders
Name matching ignores filler words, so different documents with similar names can be confused
Modified dates can be wrong after copying or syncing
a11y: Summary in a polite live region; status shown with icon and text
Focus moves to the next fix, Undo or Send as issues are resolved
Fix and Undo are labelled buttons
stops: Old draft attached instead of final
